scene_description: Black-topped table against a cream wall. A hole punch lies tipped over by the wall, a sanitizer pump lies on its back, and a tape dispenser stands at the front-left. A letter tray of paper hangs off the front edge; a pencil sharpener is in the back corner. Front is the edge away from the wall.

targets.name: hole punch
targets.description: Black and silver three-hole punch tipped over near the back-left wall, its metal base plate facing up and forward.
targets.orientation: lying on its side, base plate facing up and forward
targets.clearance_notes: Open on the front and sides, but resting on its back in an unstable pose.

candidate_improvements.description: Set the hole punch back down flat on its base.

targets.name: hand sanitizer pump
targets.description: Purell hand sanitizer pump bottle lying on its back in the middle of the table, pump nozzle pointing toward the front-right.
targets.orientation: lying on its side, label facing up
targets.clearance_notes: Open table on all sides, but the bottle is lying down.

candidate_improvements.description: Stand the sanitizer upright on its base.

targets.name: tape dispenser
targets.description: Black tape dispenser standing at an angle on the open front-left of the table.

targets.name: letter tray of paper
targets.description: Black wire-mesh letter tray holding a stack of printed paper, set at an angle with its front-right part hanging over the front edge of the table.
targets.orientation: lying flat, partly overhanging the front edge
targets.clearance_notes: Fully exposed, but the overhanging part is unsupported and could tip.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the tray back until it rests fully on the table, keeping it level.

targets.other_notes: Paper may fall out if the tray is tilted.

targets.name: pencil sharpener
targets.description: Black electric pencil sharpener with a clear shavings bin, standing alone in the back-right corner against the wall, its cord running off the back.
targets.clearance_notes: Front and sides are open, but it sits against the wall far from the front edge.

candidate_improvements.description: Unplug the sharpener, then move it approximately 15 cm toward the front.

targets.other_notes: Plugged in; must be unplugged before it is moved.

source: Staged permutation of S0023 and S0025, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
